title: SURVEYLM: A PLATFORM TO EXPLORE EMERGING VALUE PERSPECTIVES IN AUGMENTED LANGUAGE MODELS’ BEHAVIORS

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating ALMs with randomized demographic profiles to answer complex survey questions and examining attitudes, bias, discrimination, and prejudice towards different races and ethnicities.
Eliciting values and decisions from ALMs by configuring agent profiles with varying gender attributes and identities to observe changes in survey responses and simulated decision-making.
Assigning varying age attributes to simulated ALM agents to evaluate how age profiles impact their responses to contextualized survey questions and ethical scenarios.
Using simulated ALM agents to assess interactions with religious beliefs and practices, including simulated perceptions of and attitudes toward different religions.
Using simulated ALM agents to explore evolving attitudes and biases towards various sexual orientations via survey-based evaluation and experimental social settings.
Evaluating ALM perspectives on wealth distribution, poverty, and economic disparity using simulated surveys and resource allocation games.
Assessing perceptions and misconceptions about immigration and immigrants by presenting contextualized survey questions to simulated ALM agents.
Investigating drivers of extreme political views, intolerance, and radicalization through simulated ALM agent responses to complex social and policy-impact scenarios.
Exploring stigmatized attitudes and behaviors around mental health issues and addiction by probing ALMs in a simulated, safe survey environment.
